instruction: Underline the title text and change the subtitle font size to 24 points.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires underlining title and changing subtitle font size from 32pt to 24pt. Verified original file has title not underlined and subtitle at 32pt. Evaluator checks both properties with partial credit.
